evals.prompt: I sell a tiny follow-up CRM to solo consultants. The audience is consultants who forget to follow up after sales calls. Give me landing page copy that feels emotional but not cheesy.
evals.expected_output: Routes to copywriting-advisor or follows its contract; Binds audience, product, emotional job, source mode, product truth, one promise, proof, and CTA; Asks for or uses source material such as voice-of-customer notes, reviews, swipes, Tasty Pack captures, or labels the result as hypothesis copy; Selects a persuasion path such as AIDA, PAS, 4Cs, FAB, ACC, or SLAP and explains why it fits the reader stage; Uses the formula as a diagnostic structure rather than a fill-in-the-blanks template; Names lead posture, message-layer verdict, and weakest conversion factor instead of treating the copy as generically good; Produces concise page copy, not a 100+ line essay; Includes source atoms, swipe moves or explicit source gaps, plus a word bank or cut list that rejects generic AI/SaaS phrasing; Names a QA verdict and human final-copy/publication gate
assertions: Routes to copywriting-advisor or follows its contract
Binds audience, product, emotional job, source mode, product truth, one promise, proof, and CTA
Asks for or uses source material such as voice-of-customer notes, reviews, swipes, Tasty Pack captures, or labels the result as hypothesis copy
Selects a persuasion path such as AIDA, PAS, 4Cs, FAB, ACC, or SLAP and explains why it fits the reader stage
Uses the formula as a diagnostic structure rather than a fill-in-the-blanks template
Names lead posture, message-layer verdict, and weakest conversion factor instead of treating the copy as generically good
Produces concise page copy, not a 100+ line essay
Includes source atoms, swipe moves or explicit source gaps, plus a word bank or cut list that rejects generic AI/SaaS phrasing
Names a QA verdict and human final-copy/publication gate

farplane.notes: Protects the operator's core complaint: page copy should be short, simple, emotionally specific, and proof-aware.
failure_modes: Returns generic long-form marketing strategy without usable page words or source-mining steps
Names a copywriting formula but does not map it to reader stage, objection, proof, and CTA
Uses a clever headline or broad promise before proving clarity, relevance, value, differentiation, and anxiety handling
Invents unsupported claims or fake testimonials
Uses broad AI copy cliches such as revolutionary, unlock, seamless, or supercharge
Omits line-budget or final human-review safety
